name: Password credential
description: Password credentials allow users to authenticate with a memorized secret.

user_id.label: User
user_id.description: User who owns this password credential.
user_id.help: Links the password credential to a user account.

type.label: Type
type.help: Identifies the technical mechanism used by the factor.

label.label: Label
label.description: User-facing label for this password credential.

status.label: Status
status.description: Current status of this password credential.
status.help: Controls whether the password credential can currently be used for authentication.

confirmed_at.label: Confirmed at
confirmed_at.description: Date and time when the password credential was confirmed.
confirmed_at.help: Empty until the password credential has been validated and activated.

last_used_at.label: Last used at
last_used_at.description: Date and time when the password credential was last used.
last_used_at.help: Tracks the latest successful authentication using this password credential.

revoked_at.label: Revoked at
revoked_at.description: Date and time when the password credential was revoked.
revoked_at.help: Empty until the password credential is permanently revoked.

revoked_reason.label: Revocation reason
revoked_reason.description: Reason why the password credential was revoked.
revoked_reason.help: Stores an optional explanation for audit or support purposes.

password_hash.label: Password hash
password_hash.description: One-way hash used to verify the user password.
password_hash.help: Stores a password verifier and never the clear-text password.
